3:8.text: And why not do evil that good may come?—as some people slanderously charge us with saying. Their condemnation is just.

12:21.text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

5:5.text: and hope does not disappoint us, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit [verse continues: 'which has been given to us.' per site paraphrase; final words not seen verbatim]
